panels.title: Failed disks
panels.description: Number of data disks currently flagged failed (EIO/EROFS). Anything above 0 needs attention: the disk is skipped for new writes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_disk_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}) and contains(value: r.disk, set: ${disk:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "failed disks"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Quarantines in range
panels.description: Chunks quarantined (renamed to .bad) on the selected disks during the selected time range. Normally 0.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_quarantines_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}) and contains(value: r.disk, set: ${disk:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: r._value, _field: "quarantines"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
